text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, today is the day you, the<n>sage of tomes,
were ushered into our<n>world.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, this calls for a celebration!<n>Your overlord
bestows blessings<n>upon you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you very much, Opera O.<n>Your words are
more than enough for<n>me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense, trifling words are nowhere<n>near enough.
Besides, I am indebted<n>to you for saving me from
being<n>suffocated by a book when I fell<n>asleep
reading.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: As such, we will be celebrating! Nameyour favorite epic, Rob Roy, and I shallperform it for you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I can pick any epic? Then I'll<n>take you up on
that offer.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Um, can I request a versefrom the Song of Roland?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haha, the Song of Roland, is it? Justleave it to me! And... scene!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Roland is surrounded by enemies<n>from all
sides! Yet in his very moment<n>of need, a savior
appears—one by the<n>name of T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Go forth, Opera O! Smite the enemy,<n>Opera O! You
too Roland, but more<n>importantly—Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Opera O in the Song of Roland?!I've never heard this version!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But wow... what a fresh interpretation!
